Third-party libraries served locally so the app works without internet access.

codemirror/  CodeMirror 5.65.16 (MIT) - https://codemirror.net/5/  - the Markdown notes editor
../js/turndown.js  Turndown 7.1.2 (MIT) - https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown - converts old HTML notes to Markdown
../js/marked.min.js  marked (MIT), ../js/purify.min.js  DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0)
